emi.craft.info.boiler: Boiler: 3×3×3 cube of 25 boiler casings with air inside. The boiler firebox sits in the middle of a side face. Fill water via containers or pipes; steam is pushed into adjacent tanks and turbines. Water on a dry, hot boiler makes it explode.
emi.craft.info.booze_barrel: Place on a wooden scaffold. Right-click with water (bucket/cells), wheat and hops to brew beer, or sugar cane for rum (young barrel only). Beer matures: Brew → Youngster (1 day) → Beer (3) → Ale (9) → Dragonblood (27), spoiled after another 729 days; adding solids later may spoil it. Rum needs 1200 · n · 0.95^(n−1) ticks for n litres. An unused treetap on a side stops ageing; draw there with a stone mug. Punching removes the treetap (1 L is lost) or picks up the barrel with its contents.
emi.craft.info.booze_mug: Hops/wheat sets the strength, (wheat + hops)/water the food and duration, the age the intensity. Beer gives mining fatigue, when drunk repeatedly strength, slowness, resistance, nausea and damage. Finished rum gives fire resistance and resistance; spoiled drinks random ailments.
emi.craft.info.chilling_blueprint: Terraformer (2000 EU per step, range 50): water freezes, ice grows downwards, snow is laid and turns into snow blocks.
emi.craft.info.coffee: Gives speed and haste and raises both with every mug (cold up to II, dark up to VI, with milk up to VII). From level IV (milk coffee: VI) nausea, from V (VII) also damage.
emi.craft.info.coke_oven: Coke oven: 3×3×3 cube of 25 coke oven bricks with air inside. The coke oven sits in the middle of a side face (not top/bottom). Insert coal from the top or sides, extract coke at the bottom.
emi.craft.info.cultivation_blueprint: Terraformer (4000 EU per step, range 40): sand turns into dirt, dirt into grass; grass, flowers, saplings, wheat, mushrooms, pumpkins and rubber saplings grow on grass.
emi.craft.info.desertification_blueprint: Terraformer (2500 EU per step, range 40): dirt, grass and farmland turn into sand; water, snow, leaves and plants vanish, ice melts, wood catches fire.
emi.craft.info.ender_chest: All ender chests and ender pouches with the same three colours share 27 slots – anywhere, also in other dimensions. Dye on one of the three buttons on the lid changes that colour (or put dyes above the chest in a crafting grid). Diamond on the latch: personal, just for you (own storage). Sneak + right click the latch with an empty hand: global again, the diamond comes back. Breaking keeps colours and contents.
emi.craft.info.ender_pouch: Right click opens the storage of the ender chests with its colours. Sneak + right click an ender chest to take over its colours and owner.
emi.craft.info.ender_tank: All ender tanks with the same three colours share 16,000 mB of one liquid (apart from the chests). Fill or empty buckets/cells with a right click; pipes on every side. Colour buttons on top and diamond as on the chest, but on the valve knob at the front. Clicking the knob turns the valve: with pressure (redstone signal, or no signal when turned) the tank pushes up to 100 mB per tick into every adjacent tank/machine. Glows with glowing liquids.
emi.craft.info.flatification_blueprint: Terraformer (4000 EU per step, range 40): levels the ground to the terraformer's height – natural blocks above are removed, dips are filled with dirt.
emi.craft.info.high_pressure_boiler: High-pressure boiler: 5×5×5 cube of 97 high-pressure boiler casings with 3×3×3 air inside. The high-pressure boiler firebox sits in the middle of a side face. Up to 1500 °C, then 160 mB/t steam (needs 160 mB/t water). Water on a dry, hot boiler: explosion of power 10.
emi.craft.info.implosion_compressor: Implosion compressor: 3×3×3 cube below the controller (centred on top). Centre air, the 8 corners standard casings, the other 18 blocks reinforced casings.
emi.craft.info.industrial_blast_furnace: Blast furnace: 3×3, 4 high, directly behind the controller (which sits in front of the middle of the bottom layer). The two centre blocks of layers 2 and 3 are air or lava, the other 34 GT machine casings. Heat: standard 30 K, reinforced 50 K, advanced 70 K per block, lava 250 K, 500 K per heating coil tier (4 Kanthal, then 4 Nichrome coils by right-click).
emi.craft.info.industrial_grinder: Industrial grinder: 3×3×3 cube directly behind the controller (centred on a cube side). Centre water, middle layer 8 reinforced casings, top and bottom layer 9 standard casings each.
emi.craft.info.irrigation_blueprint: Terraformer (3000 EU per step, range 60): rarely starts rain; sand turns into dirt, saplings and wheat grow at once, logs grow with leaves, fire goes out, grass spreads.
emi.craft.info.large_steam_turbine: Large steam turbine: 5×5 × 9 long. The large steam turbine sits in the middle of a 5×5 end face, seven large turbine rotors in a row behind it with air around them, the shell is 161 large turbine casings. Up to 512 mB/t steam → 512 EU/t (HV); 3 high-pressure boilers are used fully.
emi.craft.info.large_water_turbine: Large water turbine: solid 5×5×5 cube of 124 large water turbine casings, the large water turbine in the middle of a side face. Flowing water up to 7 blocks around the cube and up to 24 blocks above it counts: from 64 blocks 1 EU/t per block, ×1.5 in river biomes, at most 256 EU/t (HV).
emi.craft.info.large_wind_turbine: Large wind turbine: the large wind turbine on top of 8 wind turbine masts. Right-click to insert a rotor (sneak with an empty hand to take it out). Output 20× wind mill × rotor factor (iron 50 %, steel 75 %, carbon 100 %), at most 384 EU/t (HV): y 128 ≈ 64 EU/t, y 200 ≈ 136 EU/t, thunder ×3. Blocks within ±5 of the nacelle lower the output.
emi.craft.info.mushroom_blueprint: Terraformer (8000 EU per step, range 25): mycelium spreads (mushroom fields biome), mushrooms and huge mushrooms grow on it.
emi.craft.info.solar_field: Solar field: every solar panel delivers 1 EU/t in sunlight. If it lies in a complete square of 9×9 solar panels on the same level, it delivers 1.2 EU/t (1 extra EU every 5 ticks). A 9×9 field thus yields about 97 EU/t instead of 81. The old LV/MV/HV solar arrays no longer deliver anything; at the crafting table they come apart into 8 of the tier below.
emi.craft.info.steam_turbine: Steam turbine: 3×3 × 5 long. The steam turbine sits in the middle of a 3×3 end face, three turbine rotors in a row behind it, the remaining 41 blocks are turbine casings. Steam enters through any block; up to 3 boilers are used fully.
emi.craft.info.vacuum_freezer: Vacuum freezer: 3×3×3 cube below the controller (centred on top). Centre air, the 6 face centres advanced casings, the other 20 blocks reinforced casings.
emi.craft.info.water_turbine: Water turbine: solid 3×3×3 cube of 26 water turbine casings, the water turbine in the middle of a side face. Flowing water up to 5 blocks around the cube and up to 20 blocks above it counts: from 16 blocks 0.25 EU/t per block, ×1.5 in river biomes, at most 32 EU/t.

emi.info.craft.advanced_machine: Spins up first: every tick with energy and a recipe (or a redstone signal) raises the speed by 1 (3 EU/t) up to 7500; progress grows by speed/30 per tick and is done at 4000. At full speed 16 ticks per operation for 3 EU/t. Without work the speed drops by 4 per tick; a redstone signal keeps it up (still using energy). Overclockers: faster and higher speed, but 3 · 2^n EU/t while spinning up. Redstone in the energy slot fills the whole storage.
emi.info.craft.te_fallback: The powered furnace also smelts every furnace recipe (160 MJ). The pulverizer and sawmill take every macerator recipe without an own TE recipe (GregTech): wood pulp in the sawmill (80 MJ), everything else in the pulverizer (400 MJ), without a secondary output.

gui.craft.forestry.hint.energybuffer: Engines are capable of buffering a lesser amount of energy if it cannot be transmitted to the target.
gui.craft.forestry.hint.energyunit: An engine's energy output is measured in MJ/t, which stands for "Minecraft Joule per tick". Each second has 20 ticks.
gui.craft.forestry.hint.enginetinbatteri: You can use batteries to run your electrical engines without needing to wire them up.
gui.craft.forestry.hint.enginetinchoke: Electrical engines can be outfitted with circuit boards to choke their power output to 1 MJ/t and also reduce their energy demand.

source.craft.advanced_alloy: Compressor: mixed metal ingot → 1 (mixed metal: crafting from three plates in a column, e.g. refined iron, bronze, tin).
source.craft.air_cell: Compressor: empty cell → 1. By-product of many electrolyses (sand, water, garnet, ruby, sapphire, olivine, flint, obsidian dust …).
source.craft.almandine_dust: Centrifuge: 16 red garnet dust → 3 pyrope, 5 almandine, 8 spessartine dust. The electrolyzer splits them further (magnesium, iron, manganese, aluminium).
source.craft.aluminium_dust: Many ways: industrial grinder: bauxite ore → 1, sodalite ore → 3; sodalite ore often drops it. Electrolyzer: 12 bauxite dust → 8 (best way), also sodalite, clay, ruby, sapphire, emerald, lazurite and garnet dusts. Also UU-matter (16), macerator from ingots, scrap box.
source.craft.aluminium_ingot: Industrial blast furnace (1700 K, e.g. 34 reinforced casings): aluminium dust → 1. Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.aluminium_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.andradite_dust: Centrifuge: 16 yellow garnet dust → 5 andradite, 8 grossular, 3 uvarovite dust. The electrolyzer splits them further (calcium, iron, chrome, aluminium).
source.craft.ash: Coal power plant boiler: every 4 coal (or 2 coke) → 1 in the ash slot. Centrifuge: 2 dark ashes → 2.
source.craft.bauxite_dust: Bauxite ore (overworld: plains, meadow, forests; mining dimension): macerator or industrial grinder → 4. Electrolyzer: 12 bauxite dust + 8 cells → 8 aluminium dust + 2 tiny titanium dust + hydrogen. Also scrap box.
source.craft.bauxite_ore: Overworld only in plains, meadow, forests and cherry grove, everywhere in the mining dimension; y 32–79, 2 veins (up to 16 ores) per chunk. Stone pickaxe or better, drops itself. Macerator → 4 bauxite dust; industrial grinder → 4 bauxite dust + 1 aluminium dust.
source.craft.beryllium_cell: Electrolyzer: 29 emerald dust + 18 cells → 3; 16 ender pearl dust + 16 cells → 1.
source.craft.bio_cell: Canning machine: compressed plants + empty cell. Extractor → biofuel cell.
source.craft.biofuel_cell: Extractor: bio cell → 1 (bio cell: compressed plants in the canning machine).
source.craft.brass_dust: Crafting: 3 copper + 1 zinc dust → 4 brass dust (or 3 tiny copper + 1 tiny zinc dust → 1). Macerator: brass ingot/plate → 1. Also scrap box.
source.craft.brass_ingot: Furnace: brass dust → 1 (3 copper + 1 zinc dust → 4). Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.brass_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.bronze_dust: Crafting: 3 copper + 1 tin dust → 2 bronze dust. Macerator: bronze ingot/plate → 1, bronze block → 9, wrench → 6. Mortar: bronze ingot → 1. Rotary macerator: copper with tin in the supplement slot → bronze dust instead of copper dust.
source.craft.bronze_ingot: Crafting: 3 copper + 1 tin ingot → 1 (GregTech). Furnace: bronze dust → 1 (3 copper + 1 tin dust → 2 dust, so cheaper).
source.craft.bronze_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.calcite_dust: Centrifuge: 4 lapis lazuli → 1 tiny calcite dust; calcium carbonate cell → 1. 4 tiny → 1. Also scrap box. No ore.
source.craft.calcium_carbonate_cell: Canning machine: calcite dust + empty cell.
source.craft.calcium_cell: Electrolyzer: 3 bone meal + 1 cell → 1; by-product of calcite, lazurite, andradite, grossular and uvarovite dust.
source.craft.carbon_cell: Electrolyzer: coal or charcoal dust, 2 ash, calcite dust, 32 sugar (each + empty cells). Centrifuge: 16 rubber wood + 5 cells → 4 (+ resin, plant balls, methane).
source.craft.carbon_fiber: Crafting: 4 coal dust (2×2) → 1. Two of them → raw carbon mesh.
source.craft.carbon_mesh: Crafting: 2 raw carbon fibres → 1. Compressor → carbon plate.
source.craft.carbon_plate: Compressor: raw carbon mesh → 1 (mesh from carbon fibres, these from coal dust).
source.craft.chlorite_cell: Electrolyzer: 16 ender pearl dust + 16 cells → 6; 23 sodalite dust + 8 cells → 1.
source.craft.chrome_dust: Electrolyzer: 9 ruby dust → 1 (+ 2 aluminium dust), 20 uvarovite dust → 2. 4 tiny chrome dust → 1. Very rarely from the scrap box. No ore.
source.craft.chrome_ingot: Industrial blast furnace (1700 K): chrome dust → 1 (800 ticks). Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.chrome_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.cinnabar_dust: Cinnabar ore (Nether only) drops 2 (more with fortune); ore: macerator → 3, industrial grinder → 5. Electrolyzer: 2 cinnabar dust + cell → mercury cell + sulfur dust.
source.craft.cinnabar_ore: Nether only (in netherrack), y 64–127, 1–8 veins per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better; drops 2 cinnabar dust, often also redstone (the ore with silk touch). Ore: macerator → 3 cinnabar dust; industrial grinder → 5 cinnabar dust + 2 tiny redstone + tiny glowstone dust.
source.craft.clay_dust: Macerator: clay block → 2. Mortar: clay block → 1.
source.craft.coal_ball: Crafting: 8 coal dust around a flint → 1.
source.craft.coal_chunk: Crafting: 8 compressed coal balls around obsidian, bricks or an iron block → 1. Compressor → industrial diamond.
source.craft.coal_dust: Macerator: coal → 1, coal ore → 2. Industrial grinder: coal ore → 1 (+ coal, tiny thorium dust). Centrifuge: 16 netherrack dust or 16 soul sand. Furnace: hydrated coal dust → 1. Also scrap box.
source.craft.coffee_beans: Harvest of the coffee crop (at size 5: 3 beans). The crop only appears by cross-breeding on a cross-breeding crop (crops with shared attributes cross more easily); afterwards the beans themselves can be planted on crops. Macerator → 3 coffee powder.
source.craft.coke: Coke oven (3×3×3 of coke oven bricks, no power): 1 coal → 1 in 900 ticks; charcoal is not accepted. Coke block → 9.
source.craft.compressed_plant_ball: Compressor: plant ball → 1; 4 saplings, 8 leaves (not rubber), wheat, sugar cane, cacti, dandelions or poppies → 1. Centrifuge: by-product of dirt, grass blocks and resin.
source.craft.compressed_sawdust: Crafting: 8 sawdust around an empty slot → 1. Furnace → charcoal.
source.craft.coolant_cell_10k: Crafting: 4 tin ingots around a water cell (or water bucket) → 10k; 3× 10k + 6 tin → 30k; 2× 30k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 60k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.coolant_cell_30k: Crafting: 4 tin ingots around a water cell (or water bucket) → 10k; 3× 10k + 6 tin → 30k; 2× 30k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 60k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.coolant_cell_60k: Crafting: 4 tin ingots around a water cell (or water bucket) → 10k; 3× 10k + 6 tin → 30k; 2× 30k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 60k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.copper_dust: Macerator: copper ore or raw copper → 2, ingot/plate → 1. Industrial grinder: copper ore → 2 (+ tiny gold and tiny nickel dust). 4 tiny copper dust → 1. Also mortar, UU-matter (10) and scrap box.
source.craft.copper_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.dark_ash: By-product of the implosion compressor (4–16 per run) and the industrial blast furnace (steel 2, tungstensteel 4). Electrolyzer: 4 blaze powder → 1 (+ sulfur dust).
source.craft.deepslate_galena_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 0–31, 1 vein (up to 16 ores) per chunk. Stone pickaxe or better, drops itself. Macerator → 2 galena dust; industrial grinder → 2 galena dust + sulfur dust, with a mercury cell also silver dust.
source.craft.deepslate_iridium_ore_block: Very rare: overworld and mining dimension, single blocks in about every 5th chunk, y 0–98. Diamond pickaxe or better; drops 1 iridium ore (more with fortune). Macerator → 2 iridium ore; industrial grinder → 2 iridium ore + 2 tiny platinum dust (mercury cell: 1 platinum dust).
source.craft.deepslate_lead_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 10–34, 4 veins (size 8) per chunk, mixed with 20 % silver ore (Thermal Expansion). Iron pickaxe or better, drops itself. Furnace → lead ingot; macerator → 2 lead dust; industrial grinder → 2 lead dust + tiny silver dust (mercury cell: + silver dust).
source.craft.deepslate_nickel_ore: Ferrous ore (Thermal Expansion): overworld and mining dimension, y 5–19, 2 small veins (size 4) per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better, drops itself. Furnace → nickel ingot; macerator → 2 nickel dust; industrial grinder → 3 nickel dust + tiny platinum and tiny copper dust (mercury cell: + platinum dust).
source.craft.deepslate_ruby_ore: Overworld only in desert, badlands and savanna, everywhere in the mining dimension; y 0–31, 8 single blocks per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better; drops a ruby, rarely also a red garnet. Industrial grinder (ore via silk touch) → ruby + 6 tiny ruby dust + 2 tiny red garnet dust.
source.craft.deepslate_sapphire_ore: Overworld only in ocean, beach and mangrove swamp, everywhere in the mining dimension; y 0–31, 8 single blocks per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better; drops a sapphire, rarely also a green sapphire. Industrial grinder (ore via silk touch) → sapphire + 6 tiny sapphire dust + 2 tiny green sapphire dust.
source.craft.deepslate_silver_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 5–29, 3 veins (size 8) per chunk, mixed with 10 % lead ore (Thermal Expansion). Iron pickaxe or better, drops itself. Furnace → silver ingot; macerator → 2 silver dust; industrial grinder → 2 silver dust + 2 tiny lead dust (mercury cell: 3).
source.craft.deepslate_tin_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 0–39, very common (about 25 small veins per chunk). Stone pickaxe or better, drops itself. Furnace → tin ingot; macerator → 2 tin dust; industrial grinder → 2 tin dust + tiny iron and tiny zinc dust.
source.craft.deepslate_uranium_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 0–64, about 20 small veins (up to 3 ores each) per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better; drops an uranium drop (the ore with silk touch). Compressor → uranium ingot; macerator → 2 uranium dust; industrial grinder → 2 uranium dust + 2 tiny plutonium dust.
source.craft.dense_copper_plate: Compressor: 8 copper plates → 1 (plate bending machine from copper ingots). Macerator → 8 copper dust.
source.craft.deuterium_cell: Centrifuge: 4 hydrogen cells → 1 (+ 3 empty cells, 3000 ticks).
source.craft.diamond_dust: Macerator: diamond or industrial diamond → 1, diamond tools/armour, enchanting table. Industrial grinder: diamond ore → 6 tiny diamond dust (+ diamond). 4 tiny → 1.
source.craft.dual_plutonium_cell: Canning machine: plutonium ingot + empty cell (plutonium from uranium, see plutonium dust). Crafting: 2 cells + dense copper plate → dual; 2 dual + 3 dense copper plates → quad.
source.craft.dual_thorium_cell: Canning machine: thorium ingot + empty cell (thorium from the centrifuge). Crafting: 2 cells + copper plate → dual; 2 dual + 3 copper plates → quad.
source.craft.dual_uranium_cell: Crafting: uranium cell + dense copper plate + uranium cell → dual; 2 dual + 3 dense copper plates → quad.
source.craft.electrolyzed_water_cell: Electrolyzer: water cell → 1, or water bucket + empty cell → 1.
source.craft.electrum_dust: Crafting: 1 silver + 1 gold dust → 2 electrum dust (or 2 tiny of each → 1). Macerator: electrum ingot/plate → 1 (ingots also from the centrifuge: 16 lava). Also scrap box.
source.craft.electrum_ingot: Furnace: electrum dust → 1 (silver + gold dust). Centrifuge: 16 lava → 1. Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.electrum_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.emerald_dust: Macerator: emerald → 1. Industrial grinder: emerald ore → 6 tiny (+ emerald), olivine ore → 2 tiny emerald dust. 4 tiny → 1. Electrolyzer → beryllium.
source.craft.empty_cell: Crafting: 4 tin ingots → 4. Returned by almost every GT machine once the content is used up (electrolyzer, centrifuge, industrial grinder …); air cell → 1 (crafting or extractor).
source.craft.ender_pearl_dust: Macerator: ender pearl → 1. For potassium in the electrolyzer.
source.craft.flint_dust: Macerator: flint → 2 tiny flint dust; 4 tiny → 1.
source.craft.fuel_bucket: Refinery (BuildCraft): oil → fuel 1:1; pump the fuel into a tank and fill an empty bucket there.
source.craft.galena_dust: Galena ore (overworld y 0–31, mining dimension): macerator or industrial grinder → 2. Electrolyzer: 2 galena dust → 3 tiny silver and 3 tiny lead dust each + 2 tiny sulfur dust.
source.craft.galena_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 0–31, 1 vein (up to 16 ores) per chunk. Stone pickaxe or better, drops itself. Macerator → 2 galena dust; industrial grinder → 2 galena dust + sulfur dust, with a mercury cell also silver dust.
source.craft.gold_dust: Macerator: gold ore or raw gold → 2, ingot → 1, gold tools/armour. Industrial grinder: gold ore → 2 (mercury cell: 3), copper ore with mercury cell → 1. Centrifuge: 16 glowstone dust + cell → 8. 4 tiny gold dust → 1. Also UU-matter (2) and scrap box.
source.craft.gold_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.green_sapphire: Rare extra drop of sapphire ore. Implosion compressor: 4 green sapphire dust + 24 industrial TNT → 3. UU-matter → 2.
source.craft.green_sapphire_dust: Macerator: green sapphire → 1 (rare drop of sapphire ore), tools made of it. Industrial grinder: sapphire ore → 2 tiny green sapphire dust. 4 tiny → 1.
source.craft.grossular_dust: Centrifuge: 16 yellow garnet dust → 5 andradite, 8 grossular, 3 uvarovite dust. The electrolyzer splits them further (calcium, iron, chrome, aluminium).
source.craft.heating_cell: Crafting: circuit, lava cell, dense copper plate (in a column).
source.craft.helium_3_cell: Centrifuge: 16 helium cells → 1 (+ 15 empty cells, 10,000 ticks).
source.craft.helium_cell: Centrifuge: 16 glowstone dust + 1 cell → 1 (+ 8 redstone, 8 gold dust; 25,000 ticks).
source.craft.helium_coolant_cell_180k: Crafting: 4 tin ingots around a helium cell → 60k; 3× 60k + 6 tin → 180k; 2× 180k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 360k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.helium_coolant_cell_360k: Crafting: 4 tin ingots around a helium cell → 60k; 3× 60k + 6 tin → 180k; 2× 180k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 360k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.helium_coolant_cell_60k: Crafting: 4 tin ingots around a helium cell → 60k; 3× 60k + 6 tin → 180k; 2× 180k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 360k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.hops: Harvest of the hops crop (at size 7: 3 hops). The crop only appears by cross-breeding on a cross-breeding crop (crops with shared attributes cross more easily). Ingredient for beer in the barrel.
source.craft.hot_tungstensteel_ingot: Industrial blast furnace (3000 K): tungsten + steel ingot → 2 (2000 ticks). Must be cooled into tungstensteel in the vacuum freezer.
source.craft.hydrated_coal_cell: Canning machine: hydrated coal + empty cell (hydrated coal: compressor from hydrated coal dust).
source.craft.hydrated_coal_clump: Compressor: hydrated coal dust → 1 (dust: 8 coal dust around a water cell or water bucket).
source.craft.hydrated_coal_dust: Crafting: 8 coal dust around a water bucket or water cell → 8 (or 1 + 1 → 1). Industrial grinder: diamond ore → 1. Rotary macerator: coal with a water cell in the supplement slot.
source.craft.hydrogen_cell: Electrolyzer: 6 electrolyzed water cells → 4 (+ air cell); 6000 mB water in its tank + 5 cells → 4; 12 bauxite dust + 8 cells → 5 (+ aluminium dust).
source.craft.industrial_diamond: Compressor: coal chunk → 1 (coal ball → compressed coal ball → 8 of them around obsidian, bricks or an iron block → coal chunk). Implosion compressor: 4 diamond dust + 32 industrial TNT → 3. Crafting: → diamond.
source.craft.invar_dust: Crafting: 2 iron + 1 nickel dust → 3 (Thermal Expansion). Furnace → invar ingot.
source.craft.invar_ingot: Furnace: invar dust → 1 (invar dust: 2 iron + 1 nickel dust).
source.craft.iridium_alloy_ingot: Crafting: 4 iridium ingots, 4 advanced alloys, 1 diamond dust (IAI/ADA/IAI) → 1. Implosion compressor → iridium plate.
source.craft.iridium_ingot: Compressor: iridium ore → 1 or 9 iridium nuggets → 1 (also crafting). Iridium ore: very rare GT iridium ore or UU-matter; nuggets from sheldonite (End).
source.craft.iridium_nugget: Industrial grinder: sheldonite ore → 2. Centrifuge: 1 platinum dust → 1 (+ tiny nickel dust). 1 iridium ingot → 9.
source.craft.iridium_ore: From GT iridium ore (very rare, overworld and mining dimension, diamond pickaxe): 1 when mined, 2 per ore in a macerator or industrial grinder. Otherwise only from UU-matter. Compressor → iridium ingot.
source.craft.iridium_ore_block: Very rare: overworld and mining dimension, single blocks in about every 5th chunk, y 0–98. Diamond pickaxe or better; drops 1 iridium ore (more with fortune). Macerator → 2 iridium ore; industrial grinder → 2 iridium ore + 2 tiny platinum dust (mercury cell: 1 platinum dust).
source.craft.iridium_plate: Implosion compressor: 1 iridium alloy ingot + 8 industrial TNT → 1 (+ 4 dark ashes).
source.craft.iron_dust: Macerator: iron ore or raw iron → 2, ingot → 1, bucket → 3, machine casing → 8. Industrial grinder: iron ore → 2 (+ tiny tin and tiny nickel dust). Electrolyzer: pyrite, olivine, almandine, andradite dust. 2 tiny iron dust → 1. Also UU-matter (4) and scrap box.
source.craft.iron_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.isotope_cell: Crafting: near-depleted uranium cell + coal dust. In the reactor next to active uranium cells it turns into a re-enriched uranium cell (faster at high heat).
source.craft.lava_cell: Use an empty cell on a lava source (picks up the block). Canning machine: lava bucket + cell.
source.craft.lazurite_dust: Centrifuge: 4 lapis lazuli → 3 (+ tiny pyrite, calcite, sodalite dust). Industrial grinder: lapis ore → 12 lapis lazuli + 3 lazurite dust. Also scrap box.
source.craft.lead_dust: Lead ore (Thermal Expansion): macerator → 2, industrial grinder → 2 + tiny silver dust. Electrolyzer: 2 galena dust → 3 tiny lead dust (+ tiny silver, tiny sulfur dust); centrifuge: 2 silver dust → 1 tiny lead dust. 4 tiny lead dust → 1. Also UU-matter (14), macerator from ingots and scrap box.
source.craft.lead_ingot: Furnace: lead ore → 1. Furnace: lead dust → 1. Industrial blast furnace (1500 K): 2 galena dust → 1 lead + 1 silver ingot.
source.craft.lead_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 10–34, 4 veins (size 8) per chunk, mixed with 20 % silver ore (Thermal Expansion). Iron pickaxe or better, drops itself. Furnace → lead ingot; macerator → 2 lead dust; industrial grinder → 2 lead dust + tiny silver dust (mercury cell: + silver dust).
source.craft.lead_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.lithium_cell: Electrolyzer: clay dust + 5 cells → 1 (+ sodium, silicon, aluminium).
source.craft.magnesium_dust: Electrolyzer: 9 olivine dust → 2 (+ 2 iron dust), 20 pyrope dust → 3; 4 obsidian dust → 2 tiny magnesium dust. 4 tiny → 1. Very rarely from the scrap box.
source.craft.manganese_dust: Electrolyzer: 20 spessartine dust → 3 (spessartine from red garnet dust in the centrifuge). Industrial grinder: tungstate ore → 3 tiny manganese dust. 4 tiny → 1.
source.craft.mercury_cell: Electrolyzer: 2 cinnabar dust + 1 cell → 1 (+ sulfur dust). Centrifuge: 10 redstone + 4 cells → 3.
source.craft.methane_cell: Centrifuge: almost any food (apples, meat, bread, potatoes, mushrooms, melons, pumpkin, nether wart, rotten flesh …) with empty cells; also 16 rubber wood → 1.
source.craft.mixed_metal_ingot: Crafting, three plates stacked: top refined iron/nickel (1), steel (2–3), titanium/tungsten (3–4) or tungstensteel (5–6), middle bronze or brass, bottom tin/zinc or aluminium (more ingots).
source.craft.nak_coolant_cell_180k: Crafting: 10k coolant cell + 2 sodium + 2 potassium cells + 4 tin → 60k; 3× 60k + 6 tin → 180k; 2× 180k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 360k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.nak_coolant_cell_360k: Crafting: 10k coolant cell + 2 sodium + 2 potassium cells + 4 tin → 60k; 3× 60k + 6 tin → 180k; 2× 180k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 360k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.nak_coolant_cell_60k: Crafting: 10k coolant cell + 2 sodium + 2 potassium cells + 4 tin → 60k; 3× 60k + 6 tin → 180k; 2× 180k + 6 tin + dense copper plate → 360k. The vacuum freezer cools used cells back down.
source.craft.near_depleted_uranium_cell: Crafting: 8 empty cells around an uranium ingot → 8. Centrifuge: 8 re-enriched uranium cells → 3 (+ plutonium, thorium dust).
source.craft.netherrack_dust: Industrial grinder: 16 netherrack + water cell → 16 (+ gold nugget), with a mercury cell from 8. Centrifuge: 16 → redstone, 4 sulfur, 1 coal dust, gold nugget.
source.craft.nickel_dust: Ferrous (nickel) ore (Thermal Expansion, y 5–19): macerator → 2, industrial grinder → 3 (+ tiny platinum, tiny copper dust). Otherwise as a by-product: industrial grinder: sheldonite ore → 1 nickel dust; iron, gold or copper ore → 1 tiny nickel dust. Centrifuge: 2 iron, 3 gold, 3 copper or 1 platinum dust → 1 tiny nickel dust. 4 tiny nickel dust → 1. Otherwise UU-matter (10) and scrap box.
source.craft.nickel_ingot: Furnace: ferrous (nickel) ore → 1. Furnace: nickel dust → 1 (see nickel dust). Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.nickel_ore: Ferrous ore (Thermal Expansion): overworld and mining dimension, y 5–19, 2 small veins (size 4) per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better, drops itself. Furnace → nickel ingot; macerator → 2 nickel dust; industrial grinder → 3 nickel dust + tiny platinum and tiny copper dust (mercury cell: + platinum dust).
source.craft.nickel_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.nitrogen_cell: Electrolyzer: 10 saltpeter dust + 7 cells → 2; 16 ender pearl dust + 16 cells → 5.
source.craft.oil: BuildCraft oil, overworld only: small pools in deserts (about 3% of chunks), very rarely underground oil spheres (y 20–29) with a fountain up to the surface. Scoop with a bucket or use the pump; refinery → fuel.
source.craft.oil_bucket: BuildCraft oil, overworld only: small pools in deserts (about 3% of chunks), very rarely underground oil spheres (y 20–29) with a fountain up to the surface. Scoop with a bucket or use the pump; refinery → fuel.
source.craft.oil_cell: Centrifuge: 16 soul sand + 1 cell → 1 (+ 4 saltpeter dust, coal dust, 10 sand). Oil from the world only goes into buckets and tanks, not cells.
source.craft.olivine: Olivine ore (End only) drops 1 (more with fortune); industrial grinder → 1. Implosion compressor: 4 olivine dust + 24 industrial TNT → 3. UU-matter → 2.
source.craft.olivine_dust: Macerator: olivine → 1, olivine ore → 2 (End only). Industrial grinder: olivine ore → 6 tiny, emerald ore → 2 tiny olivine dust. 4 tiny → 1. Electrolyzer → magnesium, iron.
source.craft.olivine_ore: End only: 5 veins (up to 8 ores) per chunk in end stone, y 0–127, plus floating end stone asteroids. Diamond pickaxe or better; drops an olivine. Industrial grinder (ore via silk touch) → olivine + 6 tiny olivine dust + 2 tiny emerald dust.
source.craft.plant_ball: Crafting: 8 leaves, wheat, seeds, grass, sugar cane or rubber saplings in a ring → 1; 8 saplings → 2. Centrifuge: by-product of dirt, grass blocks, resin and rubber wood.
source.craft.platinum_dust: Sheldonite ore (End only): macerator or industrial grinder → 2 (mercury cell: 3). Industrial grinder: iridium ore → 2 tiny platinum dust (mercury cell: 1 platinum dust). 4 tiny → 1. Also macerator from ingots, UU-matter (1), very rarely scrap box.
source.craft.platinum_ingot: Furnace: platinum dust or sheldonite ore (End only) → 1. Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.platinum_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.plutonium_cell: Canning machine: plutonium ingot + empty cell (plutonium from uranium, see plutonium dust). Crafting: 2 cells + dense copper plate → dual; 2 dual + 3 dense copper plates → quad.
source.craft.plutonium_dust: Industrial grinder: uranium ore → 2 tiny plutonium dust; centrifuge: 4 uranium dust → 1 tiny, 8 re-enriched uranium cells → 1 plutonium dust. 4 tiny → 1.
source.craft.plutonium_ingot: Compressor: plutonium dust → 1 (plutonium from uranium, see plutonium dust).
source.craft.potassium_cell: Electrolyzer: 10 saltpeter dust + 7 cells → 2 (+ nitrogen); 16 ender pearl dust + 16 cells → 4.
source.craft.pyrite_dust: Pyrite ore (Nether only) drops 2 (more with fortune); macerator or industrial grinder: ore → 5. Centrifuge: 10 redstone + 4 cells → 5. 4 tiny → 1. Also scrap box.
source.craft.pyrite_ore: Nether only (in netherrack), y 0–63, 1–16 veins per chunk. Stone pickaxe or better; drops 2 pyrite dust (the ore with silk touch). Ore: furnace → iron ingot; macerator → 5 pyrite dust; industrial grinder → 5 pyrite dust + 2 sulfur dust; blast furnace with a calcium carbonate cell → 2 refined iron.
source.craft.pyrope_dust: Centrifuge: 16 red garnet dust → 3 pyrope, 5 almandine, 8 spessartine dust. The electrolyzer splits them further (magnesium, iron, manganese, aluminium).
source.craft.quad_plutonium_cell: Canning machine: plutonium ingot + empty cell (plutonium from uranium, see plutonium dust). Crafting: 2 cells + dense copper plate → dual; 2 dual + 3 dense copper plates → quad.
source.craft.quad_thorium_cell: Canning machine: thorium ingot + empty cell (thorium from the centrifuge). Crafting: 2 cells + copper plate → dual; 2 dual + 3 copper plates → quad.
source.craft.quad_uranium_cell: Crafting: uranium cell + dense copper plate + uranium cell → dual; 2 dual + 3 dense copper plates → quad.
source.craft.re_enriched_uranium_cell: Made in the reactor from a depleted isotope cell next to active uranium cells. Crafting: + coal dust → uranium cell.
source.craft.red_garnet: Rare extra drop of ruby ore. Implosion compressor: 4 red garnet dust + 16 industrial TNT → 3.
source.craft.red_garnet_dust: Macerator: red garnet → 1 (rare drop of ruby ore). Industrial grinder: ruby ore → 2 tiny red garnet dust. 4 tiny → 1. Centrifuge: 16 → pyrope, almandine, spessartine dust.
source.craft.refined_iron_dust: Rotary macerator (Advanced Machines): grind iron (ore, ingot, raw metal) with coal or charcoal in the supplement slot – 1 coal lasts 128 operations. Furnace → refined iron.
source.craft.refined_iron_ingot: Furnace: iron ingot → 1. Industrial blast furnace (1000 K): iron ore + calcium carbonate cell → 3, pyrite ore + calcium carbonate cell → 2 (1500 K). Crafting/furnace: machine casing → 8.
source.craft.refined_iron_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot.
source.craft.resin: Treetap (or electric treetap) on a wet resin spot of rubber wood: 1–3 resin. Also when breaking rubber wood (1/6), from the Stickreed crop, from slime balls in a furnace and from UU-matter. Extractor → 3 rubber (furnace only 1).
source.craft.rich_slag: Induction smelter (Thermal Expansion), by-product: ore (iron, gold, copper, tin, silver, lead, nickel, also raw metal) + sand → 2 ingots + rich slag (5 %); pyrite ore + sand (10 %). Added to ore instead of sand: 3 ingots + slag.
source.craft.rubber: Extractor: resin → 3 (best way), slime ball → 2, rubber wood or sapling → 1. Furnace: resin → 1. Centrifuge: 4 resin → 14.
source.craft.rubber_leaves: Leaves of the rubber tree (taiga, forests, jungles, swamps); drop rubber saplings.
source.craft.rubber_sapling: Dropped by rubber tree leaves. Grows into a rubber tree at light level 9 or more; bone meal makes it grow at once. Extractor → 1 rubber.
source.craft.rubber_wood: Rubber trees grow in taiga, forests, jungles and swamps (most often in swamps), not in the mining dimension. Wet resin spots on the trunk: treetap → 1–3 resin, the spot refills. Breaking it sometimes drops resin. Extractor → 1 rubber.
source.craft.ruby: Ruby ore (overworld: desert, badlands, savanna; mining dimension) drops 1 (more with fortune); industrial grinder → 1. Implosion compressor: 4 ruby dust + 24 industrial TNT → 3. UU-matter → 2.
source.craft.ruby_dust: Macerator: ruby → 1, ruby ore → 2, ruby tools. Industrial grinder: ruby ore → 6 tiny ruby dust. Centrifuge: 10 redstone + 4 cells → 1. 4 tiny → 1. Electrolyzer → aluminium + chrome.
source.craft.ruby_ore: Overworld only in desert, badlands and savanna, everywhere in the mining dimension; y 0–31, 8 single blocks per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better; drops a ruby, rarely also a red garnet. Industrial grinder (ore via silk touch) → ruby + 6 tiny ruby dust + 2 tiny red garnet dust.
source.craft.saltpeter_dust: Centrifuge: 16 soul sand + 1 cell → 4 saltpeter dust (+ oil cell, coal dust, sand). Also scrap box. No ore.
source.craft.sapphire: Sapphire ore (overworld: ocean, beach, mangrove swamp; mining dimension) drops 1 (more with fortune); industrial grinder → 1. Implosion compressor: 4 sapphire dust + 24 industrial TNT → 3. UU-matter → 2.
source.craft.sapphire_dust: Macerator: sapphire → 1, sapphire ore → 2, sapphire tools. Industrial grinder: sapphire ore → 6 tiny sapphire dust. Electrolyzer: green sapphire dust → 1. 4 tiny → 1.
source.craft.sapphire_ore: Overworld only in ocean, beach and mangrove swamp, everywhere in the mining dimension; y 0–31, 8 single blocks per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better; drops a sapphire, rarely also a green sapphire. Industrial grinder (ore via silk touch) → sapphire + 6 tiny sapphire dust + 2 tiny green sapphire dust.
source.craft.sawdust: Sawmill (Thermal Expansion), always as a by-product: logs (oak, spruce, birch, jungle → 6 planks), fence gate, wooden sword/shovel/pickaxe/axe/hoe. 8 around an empty slot → compressed sawdust.
source.craft.scrap: Recycler: every item (except glass panes, sticks, snow, ice, wooden scaffolds) is used up and gives 1 scrap with a 1/8 chance. 9 scrap → scrap box; amplifier in the mass fabricator.
source.craft.sheldonite_ore: End only: 1 small vein (up to 4 ores) per chunk in end stone, y 0–127, plus floating end stone asteroids. Diamond pickaxe or better, drops itself. Macerator → 2 platinum dust; furnace → platinum ingot; industrial grinder → 2 platinum dust + 1 nickel dust + 2 iridium nuggets (mercury cell: 3 platinum dust).
source.craft.silicon_cell: Electrolyzer: sand, clay, flint, obsidian, olivine, emerald, lazurite, sodalite and garnet dusts (each + empty cells). Centrifuge: 10 redstone + 4 cells → 1 (+ mercury, pyrite, ruby).
source.craft.silicon_plate: Industrial blast furnace (1500 K): 2 silicon cells → 1 (1000 ticks). Silicon cells from the electrolyzer (sand, clay, garnet dusts …) or the centrifuge (redstone).
source.craft.silver_dust: Silver ore (Thermal Expansion): macerator → 2, industrial grinder → 2 (mercury 3) + 2 tiny lead dust. Industrial grinder: galena ore + mercury cell → 1 (+ galena and sulfur dust). Electrolyzer: 2 galena dust → 3 tiny silver dust (+ tiny lead, tiny sulfur dust). 4 tiny silver dust → 1. Also UU-matter (14), macerator from ingots and scrap box.
source.craft.silver_ingot: Furnace: silver ore → 1. Furnace: silver dust → 1. Industrial blast furnace (1500 K): 2 galena dust → 1 silver + 1 lead ingot.
source.craft.silver_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 5–29, 3 veins (size 8) per chunk, mixed with 10 % lead ore (Thermal Expansion). Iron pickaxe or better, drops itself. Furnace → silver ingot; macerator → 2 silver dust; industrial grinder → 2 silver dust + 2 tiny lead dust (mercury cell: 3).
source.craft.silver_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.slag: Induction smelter (Thermal Expansion), by-product: ore + rich slag → 3 ingots + slag (75 %); 2 dust + sand → 2 ingots + slag (25 %); 2 iron ingots + sand → 2 refined iron + slag (25 %); pyrite ore + rich slag (95 %). Furnace → rockwool.
source.craft.small_calcite_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 calcite dust (crafting), 1 calcite dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: centrifuge: 4 lapis lazuli → 1.
source.craft.small_chrome_dust: Crafting: 1 chrome dust → 4, 4 → 1. Never a by-product; chrome dust itself comes from the electrolyzer (ruby, uvarovite dust).
source.craft.small_copper_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 copper dust (crafting), 1 copper dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: centrifuge: 1 brass dust → 3, 1 bronze dust → 6, 3 gold or 3 nickel dust → 1; industrial grinder: gold ore → 1.
source.craft.small_diamond_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 diamond dust (crafting), 1 diamond dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: diamond ore → 6.
source.craft.small_emerald_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 emerald dust (crafting), 1 emerald dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: emerald ore → 6, olivine ore → 2.
source.craft.small_flint_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 flint dust (crafting), 1 flint dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: macerator: flint → 2.
source.craft.small_glowstone_dust: Crafting: 1 glowstone dust → 4. Industrial grinder: redstone ore → 2, cinnabar ore → 1. 4 tiny → 1 glowstone dust.
source.craft.small_gold_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 gold dust (crafting), 1 gold dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: centrifuge: 3 copper or 3 nickel dust → 1, 1 electrum dust → 2; industrial grinder: copper ore → 1.
source.craft.small_green_sapphire_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 green sapphire dust (crafting), 1 green sapphire dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: sapphire ore → 2.
source.craft.small_iron_dust: By-product of the industrial grinder (tin or tungstate ore), centrifuge (2 tin or 3 nickel dust) and electrolyzer (4 obsidian dust → 2); macerator: 2 iron fences → 3; Ferru crop above iron ore. 2 tiny iron dust → 1 iron dust.
source.craft.small_lead_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 lead dust (crafting), 1 lead dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: electrolyzer: 2 galena dust → 3; centrifuge: 2 silver dust → 1.
source.craft.small_magnesium_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 magnesium dust (crafting), 1 magnesium dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: electrolyzer: 4 obsidian dust → 2.
source.craft.small_manganese_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 manganese dust (crafting), 1 manganese dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: tungstate ore → 3.
source.craft.small_nickel_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 nickel dust (crafting), 1 nickel dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: iron, gold or copper ore → 1; centrifuge: 2 iron, 3 gold, 3 copper or 1 platinum dust → 1.
source.craft.small_olivine_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 olivine dust (crafting), 1 olivine dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: olivine ore → 6, emerald ore → 2.
source.craft.small_platinum_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 platinum dust (crafting), 1 platinum dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: iridium ore (block) → 2.
source.craft.small_plutonium_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 plutonium dust (crafting), 1 plutonium dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: uranium ore → 2; centrifuge: 4 uranium dust + 4 cells → 1.
source.craft.small_pyrite_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 pyrite dust (crafting), 1 pyrite dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: centrifuge: 4 lapis lazuli → 1.
source.craft.small_red_garnet_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 red garnet dust (crafting), 1 red garnet dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: ruby ore → 2.
source.craft.small_redstone_dust: Crafting: 1 redstone → 4. Industrial grinder: cinnabar ore → 2. 4 tiny → 1 redstone.
source.craft.small_ruby_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 ruby dust (crafting), 1 ruby dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: ruby ore → 6.
source.craft.small_sapphire_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 sapphire dust (crafting), 1 sapphire dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: sapphire ore → 6.
source.craft.small_silver_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 silver dust (crafting), 1 silver dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: electrolyzer: 2 galena dust → 3; centrifuge: 1 electrum dust → 2, 2 lead dust → 1.
source.craft.small_sodalite_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 sodalite dust (crafting), 1 sodalite dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: centrifuge: 4 lapis lazuli → 2.
source.craft.small_sulfur_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 sulfur dust (crafting), 1 sulfur dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: electrolyzer: 2 galena dust → 2.
source.craft.small_thorium_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 thorium dust (crafting), 1 thorium dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: coal ore → 1.
source.craft.small_tin_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 tin dust (crafting), 1 tin dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: centrifuge: 1 bronze dust → 2, 2 iron dust → 1, 1 zinc dust → 1; industrial grinder: iron ore → 1.
source.craft.small_titanium_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 titanium dust (crafting), 1 titanium dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: electrolyzer: 12 bauxite dust → 2 (the only way without UU-matter).
source.craft.small_tungsten_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 tungsten dust (crafting), 1 tungsten dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: centrifuge: 16 lava (tank or cells) → 1.
source.craft.small_yellow_garnet_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 yellow garnet dust (crafting), 1 yellow garnet dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: sphalerite ore → 1.
source.craft.small_zinc_dust: 4 tiny piles → 1 zinc dust (crafting), 1 zinc dust → 4. Comes as a by-product: industrial grinder: tin ore → 1; centrifuge: 2 tin or 1 brass dust → 1.
source.craft.sodalite_dust: Sodalite ore (End only) drops 6 (more with fortune); ore: macerator or industrial grinder → 12. Centrifuge: 4 lapis lazuli → 2 tiny sodalite dust. 4 tiny → 1. Also scrap box. Electrolyzer → sodium, aluminium, silicon, chlorine.
source.craft.sodalite_ore: End only: 8 veins (up to 16 ores) per chunk in end stone, y 0–127, plus large end stone asteroids. Iron pickaxe or better; drops 6 sodalite dust, often also aluminium dust (the ore with silk touch). Ore: industrial grinder → 12 sodalite dust + 3 aluminium dust.
source.craft.sodium_cell: Electrolyzer: clay dust + 5 cells → 2 (+ lithium, silicon, aluminium); 29 lazurite dust → 4; 23 sodalite dust + 8 cells → 4 (best way).
source.craft.spessartine_dust: Centrifuge: 16 red garnet dust → 3 pyrope, 5 almandine, 8 spessartine dust. The electrolyzer splits them further (magnesium, iron, manganese, aluminium).
source.craft.sphalerite_dust: Sphalerite ore (Nether only) drops 2 (more with fortune); ore: macerator → 4, industrial grinder → 5 (+ 1 zinc dust). Electrolyzer: 2 → 1 zinc dust + 1 sulfur dust.
source.craft.sphalerite_ore: Nether only (in netherrack), y 32–95, 1–16 veins per chunk. Stone pickaxe or better; drops 2 sphalerite dust, sometimes zinc dust or a yellow garnet (the ore with silk touch). Ore: macerator → 4 sphalerite dust; industrial grinder → 5 sphalerite dust + 1 zinc dust + tiny yellow garnet dust.
source.craft.steel_dust: Macerator: steel ingot/plate → 1, steel block → 9. Steel itself comes from the industrial blast furnace (refined iron + 2 coal dust). Also scrap box (rare).
source.craft.steel_ingot: Industrial blast furnace (1000 K): refined iron + 2 coal dust → 1 (+ 2 dark ashes), steel dust → 1. Furnace: plate → 1, steel block → 9.
source.craft.steel_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.sulfur_cell: Canning machine: sulfur dust + empty cell.
source.craft.sulfur_dust: Many ways: industrial grinder: galena (1) and pyrite ore (2). Electrolyzer: 3 pyrite, 2 sphalerite, 2 cinnabar dust or 4 blaze powder. Centrifuge: 16 netherrack dust → 4, sulfur cell → 1. 4 tiny → 1. Also scrap box.
source.craft.terra_wart: Plant nether wart on a crop above a snow block: in time it turns into terra wart (harvest at size 3). Afterwards terra wart itself can be planted. Centrifuge: 16 + 1 cell → methane cell.
source.craft.thorium_cell: Canning machine: thorium ingot + empty cell (thorium from the centrifuge). Crafting: 2 cells + copper plate → dual; 2 dual + 3 copper plates → quad.
source.craft.thorium_dust: Centrifuge: 4 uranium dust + 4 cells → 2, near-depleted uranium cell → 1, 8 re-enriched uranium cells → 4. Industrial grinder: coal ore → 1 tiny thorium dust. 4 tiny → 1.
source.craft.thorium_ingot: Compressor: thorium dust → 1 (thorium from the centrifuge, see thorium dust).
source.craft.tin_dust: Macerator: tin ore → 2, ingot/plate → 1, empty fuel can → 7. Industrial grinder: tin ore → 2 (+ tiny iron and tiny zinc dust). 4 tiny tin dust → 1. Also UU-matter (10) and scrap box.
source.craft.tin_ingot: Furnace: tin ore or tin dust → 1, plate → 1, tin can/empty fuel can. Centrifuge: 16 lava → 2 (16 lava cells → 10). Also UU-matter via tin dust.
source.craft.tin_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 0–39, very common (about 25 small veins per chunk). Stone pickaxe or better, drops itself. Furnace → tin ingot; macerator → 2 tin dust; industrial grinder → 2 tin dust + tiny iron and tiny zinc dust.
source.craft.tin_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.titanium_dust: Electrolyzer: 12 bauxite dust → 2 tiny titanium dust (+ 8 aluminium dust); 4 tiny → 1. Otherwise only UU-matter (2), very rarely from the scrap box. No ore.
source.craft.titanium_ingot: Industrial blast furnace (1500 K): titanium dust → 1 (1000 ticks). Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.titanium_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.tritium_cell: Centrifuge: 4 deuterium cells → 1 (+ 3 empty cells, 3000 ticks).
source.craft.tungstate_ore: End only: 4 veins (up to 16 ores) per chunk in end stone, y 0–127, plus floating end stone asteroids. Iron pickaxe or better, drops itself. Macerator → 2 tungsten dust; industrial grinder → 2 tungsten dust + 3 tiny iron and 3 tiny manganese dust.
source.craft.tungsten_cell: Canning machine: tungsten dust + empty cell.
source.craft.tungsten_dust: Tungstate ore (End only): macerator or industrial grinder → 2, furnace → 1. Centrifuge: 4 uranium dust + 4 cells → 1; 16 lava → 1 tiny tungsten dust. 4 tiny → 1. Also UU-matter (6), very rarely scrap box.
source.craft.tungsten_ingot: Industrial blast furnace (2500 K, advanced casings + heating coils): tungsten dust → 1 (2000 ticks). Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.tungsten_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.craft.tungstensteel_ingot: Vacuum freezer: hot tungstensteel ingot → 1 (450 ticks, 128 EU/t). Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.tungstensteel_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot.
source.craft.uranium_cell: Canning machine: uranium ingot + empty cell. Crafting: re-enriched uranium cell + coal dust. Centrifuge: 4 uranium dust + 4 cells → 4 (+ plutonium, thorium, tungsten).
source.craft.uranium_drop: Dropped by uranium ore when mined without silk touch. Compressor → uranium ingot (for fuel rods).
source.craft.uranium_dust: Uranium ore: macerator or industrial grinder → 2 (grinder + 2 tiny plutonium dust). For the centrifuge (thorium, plutonium, tungsten, uranium cells).
source.craft.uranium_ingot: Compressor: uranium ore, uranium drop or uranium dust → 1. Furnace: uranium block → 9.
source.craft.uranium_ore: Overworld and mining dimension, y 0–64, about 20 small veins (up to 3 ores each) per chunk. Iron pickaxe or better; drops an uranium drop (the ore with silk touch). Compressor → uranium ingot; macerator → 2 uranium dust; industrial grinder → 2 uranium dust + 2 tiny plutonium dust.
source.craft.uu_matter: Mass fabricator: 1,000,000 EU per UU-matter. Scrap (5000) or a scrap box (45,000) as amplifier makes every EU count six times until the value is used up. EMI shows what it makes under "Uses".
source.craft.uvarovite_dust: Centrifuge: 16 yellow garnet dust → 5 andradite, 8 grossular, 3 uvarovite dust. The electrolyzer splits them further (calcium, iron, chrome, aluminium).
source.craft.water_cell: Use an empty cell on a water source (picks up the block). Canning machine: water bucket + cell. Electrolyzer: 32 sugar + 7 cells → 5 + 2 carbon cells.
source.craft.wood_chips: Pulverizer (Thermal Expansion): oak, spruce, birch or jungle log → 1 (160 MJ). 3 wood chips → 3 paper.
source.craft.wood_plate: Compressor: 8 wood pulp → 1 (wood pulp: macerator from planks, wooden doors, chests …).
source.craft.yellow_garnet: Rare extra drop of sphalerite ore (Nether). Implosion compressor: 4 yellow garnet dust + 16 industrial TNT → 3.
source.craft.yellow_garnet_dust: Macerator: yellow garnet → 1 (rare drop of sphalerite ore). Industrial grinder: sphalerite ore → 1 tiny yellow garnet dust. 4 tiny → 1. Centrifuge: 16 → andradite, grossular, uvarovite dust.
source.craft.zinc_dust: Industrial grinder: sphalerite ore → 1 (+ sphalerite dust). Electrolyzer: 2 sphalerite dust → 1 (+ sulfur dust). Sphalerite ore sometimes drops it. Tiny zinc dust from the grinder (tin ore) and the centrifuge (2 tin or 1 brass dust); 4 → 1. Also UU-matter (10), scrap box.
source.craft.zinc_ingot: Furnace: zinc dust → 1 (from sphalerite, Nether). Furnace: plate → 1.
source.craft.zinc_plate: Plate bending machine: 1 ingot → 1 plate (50 ticks, 20 EU/t). Back: furnace → ingot, macerator → 1 dust.
source.minecraft.copper_ore: Vanilla copper with IC2 distribution: overworld and mining dimension, y 10–68 (mostly around y 39), about 15 veins (up to 10 ores) per chunk; the large vanilla veins are gone. Drops 1 raw copper. Macerator: ore or raw copper → 2 copper dust; industrial grinder (ore via silk touch) → 2 copper dust + tiny gold and tiny nickel dust.
source.minecraft.deepslate_copper_ore: Vanilla copper with IC2 distribution: overworld and mining dimension, y 10–68 (mostly around y 39), about 15 veins (up to 10 ores) per chunk; the large vanilla veins are gone. Drops 1 raw copper. Macerator: ore or raw copper → 2 copper dust; industrial grinder (ore via silk touch) → 2 copper dust + tiny gold and tiny nickel dust.
source.minecraft.raw_copper: Vanilla copper with IC2 distribution: overworld and mining dimension, y 10–68 (mostly around y 39), about 15 veins (up to 10 ores) per chunk; the large vanilla veins are gone. Drops 1 raw copper. Macerator: ore or raw copper → 2 copper dust; industrial grinder (ore via silk touch) → 2 copper dust + tiny gold and tiny nickel dust.
